title: Birthplace in New Orleans and family origins
summary: Born in New Orleans; mother from Mobile, grandmother from Santo Domingo; his father started him on drums.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: By the way, where were you born? Was it right in town here?
Right in town, where they call us.
Where did your family come from?

Well, my mother come from Mobile, Alabama, but I wasn't sure where my father was from. But he had explained to me that my grandmother had come from St. Dominguez. Oh, yes. But he never did give me that town of Eastwood. What instrument you played for you, is the bandit or the piano? No, he stomped me off on drums.
